body: Investigate options for reducing `.solace/tasks/events.db`. It logs a full task, strategy run, feature, milestone or vision snapshot on every change and is never pruned. Start with a bounded log: prune old events on `serve` and let the board rebuild from the JSON files (D-78). Compare that with compact event rows (ids and kinds) and with changing the `/events` replay protocol. Recommend the smallest safe option, its retention behavior and its tests. Do not change the task, strategy or board JSON formats. Left out: redesigning the event system in this task.
title: tasks: reduce event log size
